title: OpenSim 0.1 capability declaration (§27, §28)
description: A capability says what an issuer allows somebody to do. It is a declaration, not a token: holding the document grants nothing, and a write still has to pass the checks the version owner's implementation runs (§28 — authority is scoped per component, timeline and simulation). `actions` names the four state operations of §15 and the writing actions this client already scopes grants by; a role is not an action (it follows from what a session agreed), and an unknown action is refused because a public vocabulary that grows by accident stops being reviewable.
